summary: Testing of new HydroFlow features: /api/notifications, /api/daily-closing endpoints and frontend badges + /fechamento screen. All 8 backend tests passed. Frontend badges, notification-count indicator, DailyClosing page, filters, and driver blocking all confirmed working.

integration_issues.issue: Badge did not decrement immediately after approve click; App-level polling (30s) drives the state so the badge only updates after next poll or full navigation. Consider dispatching an immediate refetch of /notifications after approve/reject/expense action for better UX.

action_items: OPTIONAL UX: refetch /api/notifications immediately after mutating actions (approve user, approve/reject expense, signup approval) to avoid up-to-30s badge staleness.
critical_code_review_comments: daily-closing uses string-prefix range on created_at (YYYY-MM-DD ISO). This depends on created_at being stored as ISO string; if a document has a naive datetime it will be excluded. Consider normalizing storage or using proper datetime range.
server.py is a single file with all routes; consider splitting when it grows further.
seed_data_creation: Created a pending signup TEST_ user via public /api/auth/signup to validate pending_users increment; cleaned up automatically in pytest teardown; an extra pending signup also created during Playwright frontend test (visible in badge-usuarios=2).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_notifications_closing.py. Endpoints /api/notifications (admin real counts, driver zeros) and /api/daily-closing (admin only, 403 for driver, date default=today UTC) all validated. Frontend badges shown: badge-usuarios, badge-financeiro, notification-count. /fechamento renders 4 stat cards, closing-date-input, closing-today-button, closing-yesterday-button, closing-export-pdf, and closing-row-{name} rows. Driver correctly redirected from /fechamento to /.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs blocking; only UX polish suggestion to refresh notifications after mutating actions.
